## Reshape


```{r}
#--- Reshape ---#

# Reshape temperature to long: one row per grid cell × depth
woa_temp_long <- woa_temp %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE),
    names_to = "temp_layer",
    values_to = "temperature"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    depth = as.numeric(str_extract(temp_layer, "\\d+"))  # extract depth from "T0", "T10", etc.
  ) %>%
  select(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, depth, temperature)

# Reshape oxygen to long
woa_oxy_long <- woa_oxy %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE),
    names_to = "oxy_layer",
    values_to = "oxygen"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    depth = as.numeric(str_extract(oxy_layer, "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  select(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, depth, oxygen)

# Join to get T & O2 together for each grid cell & depth
woa_env <- woa_temp_long %>%
  inner_join(woa_oxy_long,
             by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "depth") ) #%>%
  #filter(depth <= 1000)  # If needed, filter region and depth range to match your fish data:
```


# Analysis

```{r}
#--- Examine ranges ---#

range_T_env  <- range(woa_env$temperature, na.rm = TRUE)
range_T_fish <- range(combined_data$temperature, na.rm = TRUE)
range_O_env  <- range(woa_env$oxygen, na.rm = TRUE)
range_O_fish <- range(combined_data$oxygen, na.rm = TRUE)

T_breaks <- seq(floor(min(range_T_env[1],  range_T_fish[1])),
                ceiling(max(range_T_env[2], range_T_fish[2])),
                by = 1)  # 1°C bins; adjust as needed

O_breaks <- seq(floor(min(range_O_env[1],  range_O_fish[1])),
                ceiling(max(range_O_env[2], range_O_fish[2])),
                by = 1)  # 1 kPa bins; adjust

T_mids <- (T_breaks[-1] + T_breaks[-length(T_breaks)]) / 2
O_mids <- (O_breaks[-1] + O_breaks[-length(O_breaks)]) / 2


#--- Binning ---#

# Bin environment
woa_env_binned <- woa_env %>%
  mutate(
    T_bin = cut(temperature, breaks = T_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
    O_bin = cut(oxygen,     breaks = O_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

# Bin fish occurrences
fish_binned <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    T_bin = cut(temperature, breaks = T_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
    O_bin = cut(oxygen,     breaks = O_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

# Full grid
T_levels  <- levels(woa_env_binned$T_bin)  # or levels(fish_binned$T_bin) – but they should match
O_levels  <- levels(woa_env_binned$O_bin)
mass_vals <- sort(unique(fish_binned$mass_bin))

full_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  mass_bin = mass_vals,
  T_bin    = T_levels,
  O_bin    = O_levels
) %>%
  mutate(
    T_mid = T_mids[match(T_bin, T_levels)],
    O_mid = O_mids[match(O_bin, O_levels)]
  )
```


## Compute availability

```{r}
#--- Count and percent ---#

# Environment
env_counts <- woa_env_binned %>%
  filter(!is.na(T_bin), !is.na(O_bin)) %>%
  count(T_bin, O_bin, name = "env_n") %>%
  mutate(env_p = env_n / sum(env_n))

# All fish occurrences
fish_counts_all <- fish_binned %>%
  filter(!is.na(T_bin), !is.na(O_bin)) %>%
  count(T_bin, O_bin, name = "fish_n") %>%
  mutate(fish_p = fish_n / sum(fish_n))

# Fish occurrences by size
fish_counts_by_size <- fish_binned %>%
  filter(!is.na(T_bin), !is.na(O_bin)) %>%
  count(mass_bin, T_bin, O_bin, name = "fish_n") %>%
  group_by(mass_bin) %>%
  mutate(fish_p = fish_n / sum(fish_n)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#--- Processing ---#
env_n_min   <- 10       # or: require at least 5 grid cells
fish_n_min  <- 1       # require at least 3 occurrences for that mass_bin


# By size
habitat_by_size <- full_grid %>%
  left_join(env_counts, by = c("T_bin", "O_bin")) %>%
  left_join(fish_counts_by_size, by = c("mass_bin", "T_bin", "O_bin")) %>%
  mutate(
    env_n  = if_else(is.na(env_n),  0L, env_n),
    fish_n = if_else(is.na(fish_n), 0L, fish_n)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    habitat_class = case_when(
      env_n > 0 & fish_n > 0 ~ "Used",        # habitat exists + fish seen
      env_n > 0 & fish_n == 0 ~ "Unused",     # habitat exists + no fish seen
      env_n == 0              ~ "Unavailable" # no ocean habitat in WOA
    ),
    habitat_class_threshold = case_when(
      env_n > env_n_min & fish_n > fish_n_min ~ "Used",        # habitat exists + fish seen
      env_n > env_n_min & fish_n <= fish_n_min ~ "Unused",     # habitat exists + no fish seen
      env_n <= env_n_min              ~ "Unavailable" # no ocean habitat in WOA
    )
  )


# All
habitat_all <- full_grid %>%
  left_join(env_counts, by = c("T_bin", "O_bin")) %>%
  left_join(fish_counts_all, by = c("T_bin", "O_bin")) %>%
  mutate(
    env_n  = if_else(is.na(env_n),  0L, env_n),
    fish_n = if_else(is.na(fish_n), 0L, fish_n)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    habitat_class = case_when(
      env_n > 0 & fish_n > 0 ~ "Used",        # habitat exists + fish seen
      env_n > 0 & fish_n == 0 ~ "Unused",     # habitat exists + no fish seen
      env_n == 0              ~ "Unavailable" # no ocean habitat in WOA
    ),
    habitat_class_threshold = case_when(
      env_n > env_n_min & fish_n > fish_n_min ~ "Used",        # habitat exists + fish seen
      env_n > env_n_min & fish_n <= fish_n_min ~ "Unused",     # habitat exists + no fish seen
      env_n <= env_n_min              ~ "Unavailable" # no ocean habitat in WOA
    )
  )
```


# Visualize

```{r}
ggplot() +
  # Unavailable habitat: flat color
  geom_tile(
    data = habitat_by_size %>%
      filter(habitat_class_threshold == "Unavailable"),
    aes(x = T_mid, y = O_mid),
    fill  = "gray",  # flat pale color
    color = NA
  ) +
  # Unused habitat: flat color
  geom_tile(
    data = habitat_by_size %>%
      filter(habitat_class_threshold == "Unused"),
    aes(x = T_mid, y = O_mid),
    fill  = "white",  # flat pale color
    color = NA
  ) +
  # Used habitat: log-scaled color by fish_n
  geom_tile(
    data = habitat_by_size %>%
      filter(habitat_class_threshold == "Used", fish_n > 0),
    aes(x = T_mid, y = O_mid, fill = fish_n),
    color = NA
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ mass_bin) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 30), ylim = c(0, 30)) +
  # scale_fill_viridis_c(
  #   name = "Occurrences",
  #   trans = "log10"  # log-transform the color scale
  # ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    name = "Occurrences",
    trans = "log10",
    low  = "white",
    high = "#254b7f"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Oxygen (kPa)"#,
    #title = "Used vs unused T–pO₂ space by mass bin"
  )
```
